content: The KeyboardEvent.isComposing read-only property returns a boolean value indicating if the event is fired within a composition session, i.e., after compositionstart and before compositionend.
conclusion: MDN官方规范明确KeyboardEvent.isComposing在输入法合成会话（compositionstart至compositionend）期间返回true，用于防止快捷键在用户输入中文/输入法组合时发生按键劫持。
